buildCaveat: uncommitted worktree; complete runtime and source fingerprints recorded

protocol.models: ABBA blocks; 3 warmups and 9 unique measured requests per input size per block; state cache and persistent pack cache disabled; loading excluded; separate unprofiled wall and instrumented GPU timing; 18 samples per build and size
protocol.visibility: Model comparisons and final GPU guards use owned hidden targets in the default context; standalone microbenchmarks use hidden isolated targets unless recorded otherwise. Only owned targets/contexts close; no browser launch or close call.
protocol.comparisonRule: inconclusive if either build block-median range exceeds 10%; win or regression requires >=5% pooled median change and >=5% separation of both block ranges; otherwise no resolved change
protocol.regression: 36 authored cases x 3 option orders x 11 models per build; not independent held-out accuracy
